The '''Migrant Merchants' Guild headquarters''' was an area in the [[Old Galactic Market]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was the site of the headquarters of the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]], a criminal organization that was involved in bribes, corruption, money laundering, and smuggling, as well as dealing in legal goods and services such as the sale of personal equipment through its vendors. [[Veor]] and [[Geeda (Coruscant)|Geeda]] were among these vendors.

The headquarters was home to both militant and peaceful members of the guild, ranging from shooters and scouts to smugglers and off-world refugee foragers. The headquarters also had a [[Dancers' quarters|facility]] for female dancers to perform and live. [[Ria Deleru]] was one of these dancers, and the dancers there were fully booked by the time she met a spacer that wished to speak with her on behalf of [[Nik Deleru]].
